cases.note: revisioned entries get __WB_REVISION__ appended through URLSearchParams (spaces, slashes, an existing query)
null, absent and empty revisions and string entries are their own cache keys
numeric revisions: 0 is falsy, the rest print with JavaScript Number-to-String, past int32 and past 2^53
non-ASCII, astral and reserved characters in revisions and paths are percent-encoded by the host URL
hashes, queries, an existing revision parameter, padding, dot segments, cross-origin and non-http entries
repeated entries with the same key are accepted and keep their first position
a conflicting revision throws after the earlier entries were added; later entries are not
a revisionless and a revisioned entry for one URL conflict, in both orders
conflicting integrities for one cache key throw; a conflicting revision is reported before the integrity
null entries and entries without a URL throw add-to-cache-list-unexpected-type with the entry in the message
URLs the host cannot parse throw a TypeError from addToCacheList and getCacheKeyForURL
getCacheKeyForURL resolves against the location and looks up the exact URL, without route variations
install fetches every entry once; a second install finds them all cached
a new version with a changed, a removed and a new entry; activate deletes outdated keys
an empty precache installs nothing and opens no cache; activate opens (creates) the precache
a 404 fails install with bad-precaching-response after the earlier entry was cached
a requestWillFetch failure becomes plugin-error-request-will-fetch
a fetch that rejects runs fetchDidFail and fails install with the host TypeError
manifest integrity reaches the fetch: the matching hash installs, the other fails
a custom cacheWillUpdate replaces the default cacheability check, so a 404 is precached
a cacheWillUpdate that refuses every response fails install with status 200
the default cacheability plugin is added on first use and removed when a custom one is added later
a redirected precache response is copied before caching (copyResponse), so the cached copy has no URL
a non-http entry: Cache.put rejects after the precache was opened (B9)
a cross-origin entry installs through the fixture and is served by the precache route (B9)
the plugin lifecycle of install for a cached and an uncached entry, and the event lifetimes
a handlerDidRespond failure rejects install although the response was already cached
two versions share one precache: v2 reuses v1 entries and its activate removes v1-only keys
a 160-entry manifest installs entry by entry and activates
matchPrecache: unknown URLs open nothing, known but uninstalled URLs open the precache, a Request argument
directory index, ignored utm_ and fbclid parameters, clean URLs, exact queries
PrecacheRoute options: no directory index, no clean URLs, custom ignore patterns with JavaScript RegExp semantics
urlManipulation receives the URL with ignored parameters removed and its URLs are tried last
the router answers only http(s) URLs: data: and about: requests are not handled (B9)
cross-origin requests reach routes with sameOrigin false and print absolute (B9)
routes are per method; the host Request normalises the six standard method names only
the first registered matching route wins, for the precache route and runtime routes alike
default handlers per method answer requests no route matched
a route catch handler runs first, then the global one; without either the error reaches the caller
unregisterRoute removes a route; unknown routes and methods throw their WorkboxError codes
createHandlerBoundToURL serves one precached URL for any request; an unknown URL throws non-precached-url
the precache strategy behind a custom route has no params, so the cache key comes from getCacheKeyForURL
a precached URL missing from the cache is fetched and, without integrity, not cached
with manifest integrity the network response repairs the precache, unless the request conflicts or is no-cors
fallbackToNetwork false throws missing-precache-entry for an uninstalled entry
an uncached precache entry while offline reaches the caller as plugin-error-request-will-fetch
CacheFirst: a miss fetches and caches in the background, then hits; offline misses fail with no-response
runtime strategies cache only status 200 by default; a custom cacheWillUpdate keeps a 404
CacheOnly: no-response without a cached entry; a CacheFirst with the same cache name fills it
NetworkOnly: every source, with the error nested in no-response
PrecacheFallbackPlugin answers a failed runtime strategy from the precache, or not at all when the fallback is absent
a throwing plugin callback at each lifecycle point
a plugin or route catch handler that throws a non-Error: each instanceof Error guard ignores it, drops it or lets it through unchanged
NetworkFirst without a timeout: the network, cached in the background by its unshifted 200-or-opaque plugin, then the cache when the fetch fails
runtime strategies cache a redirected response as it is; only the precache copies it
an invalid URL after a successful install throws, and the scenario still reports and deletes its caches (B9)
every step fails in turn after caches were opened; later steps still run
